# Tatton Interiors

> Tatton Interiors is a UK interior fit-out subcontractor based in Altrincham, Greater Manchester. It prices and delivers plastering & drylining, metal stud partitions, suspended ceilings, commercial joinery and fitted furniture, internal glazing, and toilet cubicle and washroom packages for main contractors and fit-out firms, supply & fit or labour only, anywhere in the UK. It is a sister company of Tatton Projects (main contractor) and part of the DPG Holdings group.

Key facts:
- Legal entity: Tatton Projects of Cheshire Limited (Companies House 17553626); Tatton Interiors is a trading name
- Group: DPG Holdings: Tatton Projects, Tatton Interiors, The Load Bearing Company, SiloPod, EstiMate
- Accreditations: Constructionline Gold, SSIP, CITB registered, CSCS-carded teams
- Founder: Dave Groom (20+ years: joiner, site manager, project manager, contracts manager)
- Contact: 0161 706 3880, info@tattoninteriors.co.uk, Suite 15, Peel House, 30 The Downs, Altrincham WA14 2PX
- Areas: UK-wide (England, Scotland, Wales), including London, Birmingham, Manchester, Liverpool, Leeds, Sheffield, Newcastle, Bristol, Nottingham, Glasgow, Cardiff, Cheshire

## Packages
- [Plastering & Drylining](https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/plastering-drylining): Drylining and plastering subcontractor for main contractors across the UK. Wall linings, MF, tape & joint, skim. Supply & fit or labour only.
- [Partitions](https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/partitions): Metal stud and acoustic partition contractors: acoustic walls built to your Rw rating, fire-rated and high-performance partitions to British Gypsum and Knauf systems. UK-wide.
- [Suspended Ceilings](https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/suspended-ceilings): Suspended ceiling contractors: grid and tile ceilings, MF plasterboard ceilings, bulkheads, rafts and acoustic ceilings for commercial fit-outs. UK-wide.
- [Joinery & Fitted Furniture](https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/joinery): Commercial joinery and fitted furniture subcontractor: timber slat and acoustic wall panelling, booth seating, tea points, reception desks, doorsets and shopfit joinery. UK-wide.
- [Internal Glazing](https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/internal-glazing): Internal glazing contractors: frameless and framed glass partitions, glazed office screens, glass meeting rooms, glazed doors and crittall-style screens. UK-wide.
- [Toilet Cubicles & Washrooms](https://www.tattoninteriors.co.uk/toilet-cubicles): Toilet cubicle and washroom installers for main contractors: full-height compact laminate cubicles, IPS duct panels, vanity units and washroom fit-out. Supply & fit or labour only. UK-wide.
